listen_port.description: The port on which the Apache virtual host listens.

tile_dir.description: The directory where mod_tile looks for rendered tiles.

tile_url_path.description: The URL path relative to the virtual host under which the tile set is served.

tileset_name.description: The name of the tile set, used for communication with tirex and as the directory for tiles on disk.

enable_stats.description: Whether to keep tile delivery stats (On/Off).

request_timeout.description: Timeout before giving up for a tile to be rendered.

missing_request_timeout.description: Timeout before giving up for a tile to be rendered that is otherwise missing.

max_load_old.description: Load threshold above which old tiles are not re-rendered.

max_load_missing.description: Load threshold above which missing tiles are not rendered (404 returned).

renderd_socket_name.description: The Unix socket path used to connect to the tirex render daemon.

cache_duration_max.description: Upper bound on the cacheable time for a tile in seconds.

cache_duration_dirty.description: Time dirty tiles can be cached in seconds.

cache_duration_minimum.description: Minimum cache expiry time for fresh tiles in seconds.

cache_duration_medium_zoom_level.description: Zoom level below which the Medium cache duration applies.

cache_duration_medium_time.description: Cache duration in seconds for Medium zoom level tiles.

cache_duration_low_zoom_level.description: Zoom level below which the Low cache duration applies.

cache_duration_low_time.description: Cache duration in seconds for Low zoom level tiles.

cache_last_modified_factor.description: Factor used to determine cache duration based on last modified time.

enable_tile_throttling_xforward.description: Use X-Forwarded-For header for throttling (1=first IP, 2=last IP, 0=client IP).

throttling_tiles_pool.description: Pool size in tiles for throttling tile serving.

throttling_tiles_rate.description: Top-up rate in tiles per second for throttling tile serving.

throttling_renders_pool.description: Pool size in tiles for throttling render requests.

throttling_renders_rate.description: Top-up rate in tiles per second for throttling render requests.
